items.contentSnippet:
GTA 6 is here! I used to work in marketing automation, which mostly meant clicking around Klaviyo all day. So I built the obvious thing: an agent that does the clicking while I'm in Vice City.
It runs in my Chrome through an extension (using Playwright), using the tools I am already logged into. It can build a welcome flow in Klaviyo click by click, the way I would at work.
